items.topic: Run up to 5-6 parallel reader subagents
items.claim: Queue ran 3 readers + 1 validator per round
items.fact: Operator wants more parallelism: 'up the numbers! check how many subagents you can run parallel! is it 4 max? up to 6!'. Queue.py got env NREAD (default 3) and rounds ran 5 readers + 1 validator (6 parallel) successfully.

items.topic: Cap on parallel subagents is not 4
items.claim: Agent assumed parallel subagent limit was low (3)
items.fact: Operator corrected: up to 6 parallel subagents work.

items.topic: Reader/validator batch pipeline for judo-ng reading
items.fact: Pipeline in target/judo-ng-read: queue.py (record/next/status), judo-ng-reader subagents (model @explore) per batch Cxxx writing out/Cxxx.json checked by check_batch.py, and an Opus validator (@validate) sampling an already-accepted batch each round; fail => batch re-read and repo marked suspect; pass of re-read clears suspect flag (needed code fixes: retries counter on fail, clear flag on pass). 552 batches total.

items.topic: Reader must read large files fully and mark PARTIAL
items.claim: C005 first read: Services.java 2544 lines but facts cite line <=912; 'every public static method delegates to EsmUtils after checkLoaded' overgeneralised (25 of 238 never call checkLoaded)
items.fact: Validator failed the batch; re-read read all 2544 lines in four chunks. Rule: state facts only for what code does; mark purpose PARTIAL if not fully read. queue.py now collects PARTIAL entries into a re-read list (e.g. root pom.xml 1116 lines in C041).

items.claim: Caller of getColorImage(Color) must dispose returned Image; dispose() disposes only internal field
items.fact: getColorImage stores new Image in internal 'image' field, so the picker owns it; claim was wrong (validator).

items.claim: getSelectedIconName() returns null if dialog cancelled
items.fact: Only the javadoc says so; code sets selectedIconName on every cell click (selectIcon), so behaviour differs from javadoc.

items.fact: No load method; it only queries a given ResourceSet and checks xmiid uniqueness. BaseUnitShouldBeDefined Java rule is scale-insensitive (compareTo) vs EVL == scale-sensitive (inferred).

items.topic: actionButton.evl VIRTUAL guard applies at any depth
items.claim: ui/AGENTS.md:8: VIRTUAL required for buttons 'directly on' a TransferObjectView
items.fact: Guard at actionButton.evl:9 uses getRoot(), so the rule applies at any depth under the view.

items.claim: GetPrincipalBehaviourValidations.java AGENTS row: GET_PRINCIPAL output is 1..1
items.fact: Code enforces 0..1 (GetPrincipalBehaviourValidations.java:223-224). Rule GetPrincipalOperationInputNameIsValid actually checks the operation has no input despite its name. PrimitiveValidations and TransferObjectTypeValidations compare names case-insensitively.

items.claim: northwind-model Demo.java AGENTS row: validatePsm() runs before serialization
items.fact: validatePsm runs only in the no-argument branch (line 331); the file-argument branch saves without validating (line 323).

items.claim: PayloadImpl row and root AGENTS.md:54 say __$ keys excluded from both equals() and hashCode()
items.fact: Only equals() excludes them (PayloadImpl.java 141-160); hashCode() at 163-164 returns internal.hashCode(), so equal payloads can have different hash codes. Also put()/putAll() do not wrap nested maps as Payload (getAsPayload() throws on them); only the constructor wraps. dao-api spec covers transient fields for equals only. DAO row omits batch, static-data, default-value, navigation method families.
equals() ignores __$ keys but hashCode() does not: breaks equals/hashCode contract. Expected: hashCode consistent with equals.

items.claim: README commands table lists commands
items.fact: Omits merge, fill, status which have their own docs/commands pages. items.claim: Validators described rules as constraints when they are critiques (e.g. operation.evl abstract-operation no-body/no-binding, dataMember.evl derived cannot be identifier, oneWayRelationMember.evl mapped not composition)
items.fact: Docs must state for each EVL rule whether it is constraint (ERROR) or critique (WARNING). Counts from extract_rules.py (613 rules): esm 199 constraints/41 critiques, expression 181/3, psm 115/12, ui 18/1, rdbms 11/2, keycloak 8/2, jql-ide 9/0, measure 3/4, script 3/0, jcl-ide 1/0. operation.evl in esm has ~40 rules.

items.topic: Checker line citation and DOX labelling rules
items.fact: Reader prompt updated: cite the line of the rule itself, not nearby; label a DOX row 'agrees; omits' (not 'disagrees') when true but incomplete; check_batch.py was relaxed to allow files with no identifiers (empty liquibase.evl) to have no symbols. Checker only verifies cited line exists, not that it is the rule's line.
Archived openspec changes are history and often contradict code; 676 of 7779 remaining items (9%) are archive, 24 batches 100% archive; these were moved to end of queue (deferred_archive).
